summary_en: 44,500 shares (0.50% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥35M via ToSTNeT-3 立会外取引 on 2026-08-10 at closing price ¥785/share.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: EPCO's board approved on 2026-08-07 a single-block treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST. The company will purchase up to 44,500 shares (0.50% of the 8,959,607 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥35 million. The purchase price is fixed at the closing price of ¥785/share on the approval date. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation. Results will be announced immediately after market close on the execution date. The order is limited to the specified trading window and may be partially or fully unexecuted depending on market conditions.
